portInfo.description: The Rock’s palace, cathedral and sea-facing museum make a coherent visit without crossing to every glamorous district. Fontvieille offers a quieter garden alternative; the Japanese Garden is by Larvotto, not in Fontvieille. Distinguish the principality, its neighbourhoods and the two harbours before arranging a pickup.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Allow 45–60 minutes from a tender call through landing and local transfer to Monaco-Ville; a docked seawall call still has a controlled exit and uphill approach. The itineraries budget the slower arrangement. Obtain the lift/bus or taxi route for the assigned harbour, and arrange a return to that same landing rather than relying on an assumed flat waterfront walk.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Prince’s Palace frontage — Place du Palais, Monaco-Ville. The square/view is a dependable outdoor objective; palace interiors are seasonal and not presumed open. Allow 40 minutes; official source.
Monaco Cathedral — Cathedral, Monaco-Ville. A separate religious stop; services and respectful clothing govern entry. Allow 35 minutes; official source.
Oceanographic Museum — Oceanographic Museum, Monaco-Ville. Use one substantial indoor visit rather than several cross-principality transfers. Allow 120 minutes; official source.
Saint-Martin Gardens — Jardins Saint-Martin, Monaco-Ville. Sea-facing paths provide a break from museum and stone lanes. Allow 40 minutes; official source.
Monaco-Ville lanes and fortifications — Old town on the Rock, Monaco. A distinct historic neighbourhood walk with slopes and steps. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Write down the landing harbour before ascending the Rock. “Return to Monaco port” is not precise enough when Fontvieille and Hercule are both authorized tender areas.
